stand_in.command: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo build -p hfx-cli

environment_hazards: GDAL must be installed and discoverable via gdal-config; crates/hfx-cli depends on the gdal crate and fails to build without it.
gate_orderings: The ci.yml conformance job runs the built validator over conformance/valid/* and examples/tiny/ expecting exit 0, and over conformance/invalid/* expecting exit 1. It is not covered by the five stated gates; run it via the ci.yml stand-in when touching validator behavior or fixtures.
